overview: Bike & Boot is a design-led hotel on Cliff Bridge Terrace, created from what was the Mount Hotel. It has a restaurant, bar and film club, a mix of room sizes including family rooms and sea view rooms, and sits a minute or two from South Bay Beach. Dogs are welcome.
surfTripFit: A central base a short walk from South Bay, with North Bay, Scarborough's main surf beach, about 0.7 miles away on foot. Scarborough Spa, the Rotunda Museum and the harbour are all close, so it suits mixed groups where not everyone surfs.
